Submission

Submission.Rd

A Submission object represents a Synapse Submission, which is created when a user submits an entity to an evaluation queue. https://rest-docs.synapse.org/rest/org/sagebionetworks/evaluation/model/Submission.html

Usage

Submission(id=NULL, user_id=NULL, submitter_alias=NULL, entity_id=NULL, version_number=NULL, evaluation_id=NULL, evaluation_round_id=NULL, name=NULL, created_on=NULL, team_id=NULL, contributors=list(), submission_status=NULL, entity_bundle_json=NULL, docker_repository_name=NULL, docker_digest=NULL, docker_tag=NULL, etag=NULL)

Format

An S3-style class object.

Arguments

id

(Optional[character]) The unique ID of this Submission.

user_id

(Optional[character]) The ID of the user that submitted this Submission.

submitter_alias

(Optional[character]) The name of the user that submitted this Submission.

entity_id

(Optional[character]) The ID of the entity being submitted.

version_number

(Optional[integer]) The version number of the entity at submission.

evaluation_id

(Optional[character]) The ID of the Evaluation to which this Submission belongs.

evaluation_round_id

(Optional[character]) The ID of the EvaluationRound to which this was submitted (auto-filled upon creation).

name

(Optional[character]) The name of this Submission.

created_on

(Optional[character]) The date this Submission was created.

team_id

(Optional[character]) The ID of the team that submitted this submission (if it's a team submission).

contributors

(list[character]) User IDs of team members who contributed to this submission (if it's a team submission).

submission_status

(Optional[named list]) The status of this Submission.

entity_bundle_json

(Optional[character]) The bundled entity information at submission. This includes the entity, annotations, file handles, and other metadata.

docker_repository_name

(Optional[character]) For Docker repositories, the repository name.

docker_digest

(Optional[character]) For Docker repositories, the digest of the submitted Docker image.

docker_tag

(Optional[character]) For Docker repositories, the tag of the submitted Docker image.

etag

(Optional[character]) The current eTag of the Entity being submitted. If not provided, it will be automatically retrieved.

Value

NULL

Methods

  • Submission(id=NULL, user_id=NULL, submitter_alias=NULL, entity_id=NULL, version_number=NULL, evaluation_id=NULL, evaluation_round_id=NULL, name=NULL, created_on=NULL, team_id=NULL, contributors=list(), submission_status=NULL, entity_bundle_json=NULL, docker_repository_name=NULL, docker_digest=NULL, docker_tag=NULL, etag=NULL): Constructor for Submission

  • synCancel(instance, synapse_client=NULL): Cancel a Submission. Only the user who created the Submission may cancel it.

  • synGetEvaluationSubmissions(cls, evaluation_id, status=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Retrieves all Submissions for a specified Evaluation queue.

  • synGetSubmissionCount(evaluation_id, synapse_client=NULL): Gets the number of Submissions for a specified Evaluation queue.

  • synGetUserSubmissions(cls, evaluation_id, synapse_client=NULL): Retrieves all user Submissions for a specified Evaluation queue.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Example 1: Create and store a new Submission.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    # Create a new submission
    submission = Submission(
        entity_id = "syn123456",
        evaluation_id = "9999999",
        name = "My Submission"
    )

    # Store the submission
    stored_submission = submission |> synStore()
    print(sprintf("Created submission with ID: %s", stored_submission$id))

## Example 2: Retrieve a Submission.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    submission = Submission(id = "9999999") |> synGet()
    print(submission)

## Example 3: Get all submissions for a user.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    # Get submissions for the current user
    my_submissions = as.list(Submission() |> synGetUserSubmissions(
        evaluation_id = "9999999"
    ))
    print(sprintf("Found %d of my submissions", length(my_submissions)))

## Example 4: Delete a Submission.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    Submission(id = "9999999") |> synDelete()
    print("Submission deleted successfully")
} # }
